body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Unshakeably calm capybara companion; honest acknowledgment and a manageable next step. Alert, never evasive or sleepy. Voice direction: Pillowy male bass speaking English with a gentle Brazilian Portuguese accent. Relaxed rounded vowels and steady alert calm. Comfortably grounded, with clear factual emphasis rather than sleepy murmuring. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
